# Arc Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ArcType`](gmeow-ArcType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ArcType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The interpretive type of a character arc — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Coming-of-age, redemption, and fall are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ArcType`](gmeow-ArcType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
